name: Stepping Stones
description: Steps in a process as flat stones across a strip of water: wet and dark behind you, rings spreading from the one you stand on, dry and pale ahead.

props.name: steps
props.description: One stone per step, in order. The id also seeds the stone's shape.

props.name: current
props.description: Index of the current step. Changing it sends a hop of ripples from the old stone to the new one.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: When given, the stones of completed steps become buttons that go back to them.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A row of stones with labels beneath, or a column with labels beside.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the navigation landmark. The steps are an ordered list and the current one has aria-current="step".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the nav element. Other nav props are passed through.
